author: /root/weight_space_paper_review
status: Read-only metadata, source and research assessment; no model execution or parameter payload read.

metadata_scope.limits: These are checkpoint index entries, not neuron importance, capability or runtime memory. No parameter values were inspected. The merged vision weights have not been proved identical to upstream BU.

weight_groups.metadata: RGB; temporal patch 2, spatial patch 16, visual width 1152, 2304 learned position embeddings.
27 blocks, 16 heads, hidden width 1152, MLP width 4304.
Spatial merge 2 joins four patch features; merger width 4608, output width 2048.
Three intermediate visual taps at indices 8,16,24; their outputs supplement early text layers.
48 layers, width 2048, 32 query heads and 4 KV heads, head dimension 128. These layers combine language and visual tokens.
128 experts, 8 selected per token, expert intermediate width 768. There are 96 packed expert entries, 48 routers and 96 layer norms.
Vocabulary 151936. Separate checkpoint head and embedding entries; top-level tie_word_embeddings is false.

existing_intervention.targets: All 48 text layers, q/k/v/o projections. Every saved A/B key belongs to text attention. No retained vision, merger, router or expert delta exists in this adapter.
existing_intervention.evidence: Lambda0.5 improved the fixed DOM-assisted MiniWoB subset from14/24 to21/24 with3 regressions. Pure screenshot or native desktop improvement is untested. Lambda0 is not verified raw BU.

defensible_next_work.first_development_run: Root plans lambda 1, 0.5 and 0.25 under the same concise DOM-assisted MiniWoB policy. This is separate from the new adam_screen_v1 screenshot-only development and verification fixture harness. Freeze variants, budgets and selection rules before outcomes.

optional_main_merger_calibration.status: A bounded exploratory sensitivity experiment. It has no known task-trained direction and no promised benefit.
optional_main_merger_calibration.formula: Wg=BF16(g*FP32(Woriginal)); bg=BF16(g*FP32(boriginal)). Gain1 copies original bytes.
optional_main_merger_calibration.meaning: Scale both weight and bias to approximate gain on the entire affine output. BF16 rounding prevents exact algebraic equivalence. This affects the main image embedding path only; DeepStack remains separate. Downstream normalization may suppress or amplify the change.
optional_main_merger_calibration.fixed: Keep patch/position, all27 ViT blocks, main fc1/norm, all DeepStack mergers, routers/experts and the chosen text edit fixed.
optional_main_merger_calibration.future_deepstack_keys: visual.deepstack_merger_list.{0,1,2}.linear_fc2.{weight,bias}, with the same expected TP1 shapes; separate scope would be required.

defensible_next_work.unsupported: Do not copy neuron indices or directions from another architecture, infer skills from tensor patterns, or scale all vision/router weights blindly. Targeted direction removal first needs development-only activation and behavior evidence.

future_edit_correctness_gates: Verify exact checkpoint/source/runtime, full load receipt, unquantized BF16 CUDA, TP1/PP1, actual names/shapes/strides/device/class and finite values before writing.
Check both targets against every named parameter, including duplicate aliases. Retain immutable CPU originals and their hashes; do not replace Parameters.
Edit only with no unfinished request. Rebuild each gain from originals, check finite FP32/BF16 values and copy readback, and verify exact gain1 restoration. Partial edits prohibit inference.

After editing, clear prefix/KV cache, multimodal processing cache and encoder-output cache. reset_encoder_cache is essential for vision edits; reset_mm_cache alone is insufficient. Require successful reset returns and identical baseline handling.

Keep image processing, decoding, token limits, warmups and cache policy identical. Save PNG hashes, dimensions, resizing/patch grid, tokens, raw replies, coordinate transforms, actions, oracle results and complete episode duration.
verification_requirements: All known MiniWoB24 cases and prior synthetic results are exposed development or regression evidence, not a new holdout.
Reserve verification layouts, assets and seeds before tuning. Policy observations must exclude target boxes, DOM labels/IDs and oracle state. Candidate selection uses development outcomes only.
Freeze one candidate before paired verification; include all failures. No rerun-until-perfect, dropped samples, extended timers or selecting only winning tasks.

Eight perfect synthetic cases do not establish universal accuracy. Separate grounding, action execution and multi-step task completion; browser-rendered desktop/mobile layouts are not native OS control.

An Astra comparison needs an identified model and comparable inputs, tools, time limits and cost accounting. An interactive assistant of unverified identity or a game demonstration cannot establish10x superiority.
Neal403/framing refusal is a browser/network restriction encountered before model evaluation; changing weights cannot resolve that recorded blocker.

primary_sources.finding: The Qwen3.5-0.8B experiment allowed up to50 forward-pass batches on training practice problems, without gradients. Removing a looping direction in MLP layers15/19 changed131072 weights: MATH5007.9→48.1%, GSM8K13.8→67.1%, IFEval21.0→62.3. The author report also records no material improvement for nonlooping Gemma3-270M. Evaluation sets were withheld from the editor.
primary_sources.limit: This supports fixing a diagnosed obstruction. It does not demonstrate arbitrary skill creation or a transferable BU vision/MoE edit.

primary_sources.finding: BU names Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct as its base and browser-use as its intended harness. Upstream claims are not measurements of this edited checkpoint.

Image features replace image placeholder embeddings; DeepStack supplements early language hidden states. Screen behavior depends on the vision tower, connectors, text attention/MoE and output decoding.

The visual prefix mapping, main merger, three DeepStack mergers and RowParallelLinear output projection establish the expected names and shapes. These are source predictions pending runtime validation.
The MoE wrapper constructs self.visual as Qwen3_VisionTransformer and adds DeepStack features to early text layers.
RowParallelLinear has an unsharded output bias and default skip_bias_add=False. Scaling weight alone does not scale the entire affine map.
reset_encoder_cache explicitly invalidates vision embeddings after weight changes; it is separate from reset_mm_cache.
Encoder reset clears scheduler state and physical worker cache. Resetting with unfinished requests can desynchronize state.

ScreenSpot-Pro measures high-resolution grounding across23 applications and3 operating systems. Its cascaded search result shows that localization and resolution can affect accuracy without weight training; historical results are not current SOTA claims.
OSWorld measures369 real computer tasks with execution-based scoring. Screenshot grounding alone is not full task completion; historical release scores are not an Astra comparison.
